build.test_note: cargo test --release --lib --no-run uses unchanged opt-level 3/thin LTO

interpretation: Vanilla one-caller throughput repeats improve roughly 4–5%.
Terralith one-caller samples improve roughly 1–3%; small change and noisy.
Terralith two-caller pairs disagree (+14%, -4%); concurrent throughput benefit is inconclusive.
Logical traffic falls about 37–38%; readback volume is unchanged.

Standalone lighting API has preassembled input, so new packing adds work not present in its reference. It remains 5–8% slower on saved region tiles; production tile packing reuses per-region descriptors and avoids the existing dense copy.
No process RSS reduction is claimed. Peaks include shader compilation/caches and vary.
Input compaction is enabled on measured Metal backend. Other backends remain dense unless explicitly overridden.
Constant-light output descriptors, complete 8-caller/DH/Chunky lifecycle and remaining goal areas are still pending.
scope: Native lit-MCA, 900 lit interior chunks; no Java loading/rendering
